title: plugin-security: pin emptying a master and the lifecycle verbs under writeRequiresMasterRead; fix the gate's stale "asks EDIT" comments
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Follow-up of #33250 (PR #33369). Contract review 6881744779, findings N2 and N4.

- **N4, pins:** two shapes the opt-in covers by construction have no test under `sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead: true` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.test.ts`: (a) an update that empties an optional master (the PR body lists it among covered paths); (b) the lifecycle verbs `transfer`, `restore`, `purge` on an opted detail (the gate is verb-blind, step 2.8, so they ask read). Add one admit and one refuse pin for each, ablated against the read branch.
- **N2, comments:** in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`, the `askBodyNamedMaster` docblock and the fifth owner-leg condition still say unconditionally that a body which empties an optional master, or names a new one, "asks EDIT". On an opted-in detail it asks READ (the file's new header says so). Make them conditional on the hop's opt-in.
- Also the file header's "A detail that does not declare it is answered byte for byte as before" (review N1): true only when no `controlled_by_parent` master on its chain declares the key; say that.

Tests and comments only; no runtime or published surface moves. Waits for #33369 to merge.
